## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem and what this PR changes for users or contributors.

## Issue and scope

Link the maintainer-approved issue for substantive changes. Small fixes do not
require an issue. Explain any agreed change to the proposal's scope.

## Validation

List relevant checks and their results, including checks not run. Mention
documentation, changelog, or migration updates when applicable.

See [Contributing](https://github.com/Tachion-Oy/robozium/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
